basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Project Scientist II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur has invited online applications for one Project Scientist II - Research post in the DBT-funded project IndiaCAN-Twin, a purely time bound research project. The consolidated compensation is up to 67000 per month (HRA as applicable) for 24 months or until the project ends, whichever is earlier. The essential qualification is a Doctoral Degree in Science or a Masters/Integrated Masters in Engineering or Technology, plus 3 years of research and development experience. The last date to apply is 20 Nov

how_to_apply: The notice invites applications online for this assignment, to be made by 20 November 2026. It does not print the web address of the application portal; the notice was published through the ERP of IIT Kharagpur.

The application fee is shown as Rs. 0 for every category. The notice also says the fee is to be deposited by RTGS/NEFT/NET Banking etc. and that the transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form. The account printed is:
Bank name: State Bank of India (00202)
Bank address: P.O: Kharagpur Technology, Dist: Midnapore; West Bengal-721302
Name of bank account: IIT SRIC-OM Account

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Experience: 3 years of experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services. The qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: Doctoral Degree in Science or Masters/Integrated Masters in Engineering or Technology from a recognized University or equivalent

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated compensation is up to 67000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. HRA is paid as applicable. An increment of 5% for every 2 years of experience is given, subject to performance review. The assignment is for 24 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice refers to an interview, stating that possession of the minimum qualifications and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for it. It does not describe the interview date, mode or marking.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Scientist II - Research posts are vacant at IIT Kharagpur?
faq.answer: The notice announces 1 post of Project Scientist II - Research.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIT Kharagpur Project Scientist II - Research?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for this post?
faq.answer: A Doctoral Degree in Science or Masters/Integrated Masters in Engineering or Technology from a recognized University or equivalent, and 3 years experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 years, counted as on the last date of the advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules, if any.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Project Scientist II - Research post?
faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is up to 67000 per month, depending on qualification and experience, with HRA as applicable.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notice shows the fee as Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Applications are invited online. The transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) of the fee deposit should be mentioned in the Application Form.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the assignment?
faq.answer: The tenure is 24 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notice describes it as a temporary assignment in a purely time bound research project.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any increment during the tenure?
faq.answer: An increment of 5% for every 2 years of experience is given, subject to performance review.
